data.name: BookingCardList_Desc
data.value: Card list of Bookable Resource Bookings for Field Service mobile.

data.name: Bookings_Desc
data.value: Bookable Resource Booking view to display (filters which bookings appear).

data.name: ActiveTabName_Desc
data.value: Label for the first tab, which shows the started (Traveling / In Progress) job. Defaults to Active.

data.name: Tab1Name_Desc
data.value: Fallback name for tab 1. Overridden by env var prx3_BookingTab1Name. Defaults to Today.

data.name: Tab2Name_Desc
data.value: Fallback name for tab 2. Overridden by env var prx3_BookingTab2Name. Defaults to Tomorrow.

data.name: Tab3Name_Desc
data.value: Fallback name for tab 3. Overridden by env var prx3_BookingTab3Name. Defaults to Complete.

data.name: AllJobsTabEnabled_Desc
data.value: Add a final read-only tab listing all engineers' bookings for the next N days (see All Jobs: Days Ahead). Off by default.

data.name: AllJobsTabName_Desc
data.value: Label for the All Jobs tab. Defaults to All Jobs.

data.name: AllJobsDays_Desc
data.value: How many days ahead (from today) the All Jobs tab covers. Defaults to 7.

data.name: ConfigSource_Desc
data.value: Where the day windows and the custom status come from. Field Service Settings (default) reads them from the msdyn_fieldservicesetting record. This control reads them from the properties below, with no Dataverse dependency.

data.name: ActiveBookingDays_Desc
data.value: Days back a started (Traveling / In Progress) booking still counts as Active. Blank or 0 = no limit. Used only when Configuration Source is This control.

data.name: CompletedBookingDays_Desc
data.value: Days back a finished booking still shows on the Complete tab. Blank or 0 = no limit. Used only when Configuration Source is This control.

data.name: NextBookingDays_Desc
data.value: Days ahead for the optional Next N Days tab. Blank or 0 hides the tab. Used only when Configuration Source is This control.

data.name: CustomStatusLabel_Desc
data.value: Display text for an optional extra status action (for example No Access). Used only when Configuration Source is This control.

data.name: CustomBookingStatusId_Desc
data.value: The Booking Status record id (GUID) the custom status sets. Blank = the custom status is off. Used only when Configuration Source is This control.

data.name: CustomSubStatusId_Desc
data.value: The Work Order Sub-Status record id (GUID) set alongside the custom status. Optional. Used only when Configuration Source is This control.

data.name: ExtraField_Desc
data.value: Logical name of a column to show on the card (value only). Prefix with "workorder." for a Work Order field; default is the booking. Blank = not shown. For a lookup, use its "_logicalname_value" form.

data.name: ExtraFieldsTitle_Desc
data.value: Optional heading shown above the custom field values (Extra Field 1-3). Only appears when at least one value is present. Blank = no heading.

data.name: HeaderField_Desc
data.value: A column to show as a badge in the card header (e.g. Work Order job type). Prefix with "workorder." for a Work Order field; default is the booking. Lookups use "_logicalname_value". Blank = off.

data.name: PriorityColours_Desc
data.value: Colour the card top border and show a priority pill, by Work Order priority. Format: "Name=#hex" pairs separated by ";" e.g. High=#D13438;Medium=#F7A600;Low=#107C10. Blank = off.

data.name: MapsProvider_Desc
data.value: Which maps app to open when the address is tapped.

data.name: StatusLocked
data.value: Finish the active job before updating others.

data.name: OpenLocked
data.value: Finish the active job before opening another.

data.name: OpenLockedStart
data.value: Set this job to Traveling or In Progress to open it.

data.name: StatusLockedCompleteTip
data.value: This job is complete and can no longer be updated.

data.name: ErrorPrefix
data.value: Couldn't load bookings. Check your connection and reopen the record; if you're offline the cards shown are saved on this device.

data.name: NoStatusFound
data.value: No active Booking Status is set up for this action. Ask your administrator to add it in Field Service ▸ Settings ▸ Booking Statuses.

data.name: NoSubStatusFound
data.value: No Work Order Sub-Status is set up for this outcome. Ask your administrator to add one in Field Service ▸ Settings.

data.name: OfflineIcon
data.value: Offline — showing data saved on this device

data.name: NextTabName_Desc
data.value: Label for the optional next-N-days tab. {0} is replaced with the number of days, e.g. "Neste {0} dager".
